published.source: the DPS Report's main run on this request (pipeline.sh, 2026-11-26), 20,000 iterations, 180 ± 20 s, after the Phase 0 re-rank round

summary: Keeps Judgement of the Crusader on the boss for the raid.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Pre-pull: Seal of the Crusader at -1.5s
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull, for the duty. It adds 161 Holy damage taken for 40s. The paladin's melee hits refresh it, so one cast lasts the fight. Judge it again only if it drops
Seal of Command whenever it's down, before Consecration, so it goes right after the opening Judgement
Consecration on cooldown at any mana
Seal of Command whenever it's down (no twisting)
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Holy Strike
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage as well as physical, and Vengeance stacks up to 5 times, as the November 2 development notes announce. Client 1.60.1.70753 still has Physical only and 3 stacks; the sim takes the notes' values until a hotfix or client build says otherwise (standards 37).
The duty costs 0.5 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (974.4 against 974.9, 20,000 iterations, seed 1).
Wears Libram of Law. Libram of Fervor (+33 to Judgement of the Crusader) would add 9.7 DPS at 180s, but it has no known Forever source yet.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: Request: paladin__level_60_shock_ret with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_shock_ret_crusader_duty rotation, and Libram of Fervor (23203) in the relic slot, as level60_phase1_synthetic_crusader_duty. Hand edits of the base request, as the other duty paladins were made (mksettings with -apl level60_shock_ret_crusader_duty writes the same rotation). A raid sim variant (docs/raid_sim.md, M1b), in the DPS report since 2026-10-30. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Talents, rotation and its notes re-searched on 2026-11-01 for the launch realms' October 30 hotfix trees (1.60.1.70707+hf); the request is the earlier one with the new talentsString and rotation (tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh). 2026-11-24 (Phase 0 step 4, orchestration/round_notes_2026-11-11/phase0_step4_shaman_ret.md): gear moved from the synthetic set (level60_phase1_synthetic_crusader_duty, published 1008.8) to the Phase 0 set (level60_phase0_ret); request from mksettings -gear level60_phase0_ret with the same edits as above. Talents re-searched on the Phase 0 set (melee hit 5% from gear) and kept. The synthetic set wore Libram of Fervor; it has no known source in Forever (Wowhead's Forever data says drop with no NPC, our data has none), so the Phase 0 set keeps Libram of Law. Phase 0 re-rank (2026-11-25): own set level60_phase0_ret_shock, the ret set with Warblade of Caer Darrow, since the ret list's Blackblade of Shahram loses 6.1 on Shock (898.1 against 904.3). A RANK_ONLY of main hand and trinkets on the Shock request keeps Warblade (Destiny, over the line, aside) 1.2 above The Blackrock Slicer, and Heart of Wyrmthalak ties Blackhand's Breadth.
